messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Good progress! You've turned off Airplane Mode and now have cellular service. However, 2G networks are generally not suitable for mobile data and will result in very slow speeds. Let's improve this by changing your network mode preference to allow your phone to connect to faster networks like 4G and 5G.

Please use the `set_network_mode_preference` action on your phone with the mode set to `"4g_5g_preferred"`. This will allow your phone to connect to the fastest available network.

After you've done that, let me know when it's complete, and then we'll check your network status again to see what network type you're connected to and your signal strength.

I have set the network mode preference to 4G/5G preferred. My status bar now shows excellent signal with 5G and mobile data enabled. What is the next step to ensure my mobile data is working properly with excellent speed?

Please complete the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
